name: Love Seat
source:
You were supposed to meet a blind date tonight. But then you got abducted and dropped into a dank basement with strangers. Who’s behind this?

[From [url=https://closing-shift.itch.io/love-seat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今晚你应该去见一个相亲对象。但后来你被绑架了，和陌生人一起扔进了一个潮湿的地下室。这背后是谁？

[来自[url=https://closing-shift.itch.io/love-seat]Itch.io[/url]]
